work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act charges the bishop of Basel to choose canons for Bern, Aargau and Thurgau acceptable to their governments. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF11676; own dating clause LF11719–11722 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima sexta decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF11739 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
